content.short: Spheron Network powers a global, community-driven data center for affordable, scalable GPU compute access.
content.description: Spheron Network is building a community-powered data center to unlock affordable, scalable compute access for developers and AI-native applications. By aggregating idle GPUs from personal devices, data centers, and mining farms, it creates a decentralized GPU marketplace designed to support AI development with flexible, on-demand resources. The initiative aims to reduce costs and improve the availability of compute in the $477 billion GPU market, which is projected to continue growing through 2030.
